comment: Level 2 observation bay. First frame is the live primary spawn without look_at or camera takeover. The near-window frame and motion strip show the noncombat Notary through an authoritative glass solid. Run with FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m02-persons-unknown.json and FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0.

states.name: unforced_gallery_spawn
states.note: No look_at, walk or camera takeover before the first live frame.

states.name: shotgun_first_claim
states.note: The ordinary gallery route grants the Shotgun before any pane shot.

states.name: notary_window
states.note: Standing behind the existing gallery sill, see one drifting Notary in the sealed east bay through glass.

states.name: closer_gallery_inspection
states.note: An optional ordinary walk along the upper gallery gives a closer look. No camera takeover or encounter skip.

states.name: glass_blocks_shot
states.note: An ordinary acknowledged Shotgun blast aimed at the Notary ends in a solid impact on the visible glass. The server geometry test pins the exact hit volume.
